hooks.command: f=$(jq -r "(.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path) // empty"); case "$f" in */assets/terminal/ghostty/*) mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/ghostty/themes" && cp -f "$f" "$HOME/.config/ghostty/themes/$(basename "$f")" && printf '{"systemMessage":"calm: synced %s into Ghostty"}' "$(basename "$f")";; esac
